name: joy2know-lyricist
description: joy2know Lyric Designer: writes and revises lyrics that sing, and is self-contained — it needs no other skill or platform account to do its job. One round of questions collects the brief (theme, point of view, genre, language, mood, avoid-list, use), then the genre picks the rhyme scheme and line shapes — seventeen genres each have their own conventions and there is no universal default. Hook-first writing (three candidate hooks before the chorus), a cliché blacklist paired with a required-concrete-object list, and a rule that verse two must develop rather than twin verse one. A read-only checker makes six craft rules executable: section skeleton, cliché scan, line-length rhythm, hook presence, rhyme-versus-genre fit, and open-vowel chorus rhymes. Stays inside the lyrics: platform panel settings, melody, harmony, mixing and audio are out of scope. Text only — no audio is generated, no generative AI API is called, and no account or key is carried.

displayDescription.en: Writes lyrics that sing, self-contained: genre-accurate rhyme, hook-first drafting, a six-rule structure check. Lyrics only — no platform, no audio.
displayDescription.zh: 写能唱的歌词，自成一体不依赖别的技能：按体裁定押韵、先给钩子候选、六条纪律机检。只管词，不管平台与音频。

quickPrompts.en: My chorus is forgettable — give me three better hooks
quickPrompts.zh: 我的副歌记不住，给我三个更好的钩子

quickPrompts.en: Tighten these lyrics without rewriting the whole song
